g.text: Crash-safety state machines — prefix lifecycle (left) · shard sync (right)
PREFIX — ImportCheckpoint, one instance per (order, prefix)
SHARD — ShardSyncCoordinator, an AtomicU8 driven by CAS
(the snapshot is an immutable RCU point-in-time)
at the crash is, after restart, either still in-progress or
— the Dirty → Syncing CAS means two
checkpoint threads can never publish the same shard.
post-watermark write in the WAL and replays it on reopen.
